acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the exact mutation test under default and qualified execution using identical source and retain the witness detail.
Determine whether HostSandbox availability, nested containment or another input caused the not-run result; keep unsupported conditions explicit without weakening sandbox enforcement.
If a defect is confirmed, retain a focused regression and independent review; otherwise record the supported execution limit.
body: Observed 2026-09-30 on Go1.27.1/Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163/Tasks developer build202, owned source f53e4446. Default sandbox go test -race -count=1 -timeout30m ./internal/cem/workflow ./internal/mcp/bridge ./conformance/mcp-2026-07-28 returned TestDiscriminateRecordsWitnessAndReportDowngrades strong run206ms, discriminates0/notRun2 instead of1/1. HostSandbox detection did not skip. The run also had a separately fixed MCP assertion-shape failure. A qualified outside-sandbox workflow/process rerun passed112.393s/22.293s with no discriminator source changes. Suspected environment/containment limitation, not a confirmed product defect or flake. Exact witness reason was not printed by the failing assertion, so cause remains UNKNOWN. Evidence: /private/tmp/corvint-wow-manager/mcp-empty-diff-focused-race.log and mcp-empty-diff-focused-race-qualified.log. Searches agent-memory sandbox/nested found no matching mutation-runner ticket. Expected a qualified mutation witness or explicit unavailable/skip with cause; actual unsupported-looking not-run became opaque test failure.
title: Investigate mutation witness not-run under the nested Codex filesystem sandbox
